hashing.input: Exact bytes of each named file in the installed game's Contents/Resources/Content/Scripts directory (sources/Scripts in the source archive named by ui_terminology.json sourceEvidence).
hashing.normalization: None. No BOM, newline or encoding normalization: the shipped CRLF bytes are hashed as read by save_investigation._capture_native. AppleDouble ._* files are never inputs.

storyReset.verifies: StoryResetData.TextLines as the native reset boundary that authorizes installed-source dialogue investigation and dialogue edits.

questRewardOwners.verifies: CashOutQuest, AddResource and the resource OnAdded/last-resource policies replayed by offline quest reward grants.
